code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and increased monocytes and basophils, with mild neutropenia. Red cell indices are within normal limits except for slightly increased RDW. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are normal, except for low ALT. Findings may suggest a viral infection or bone marrow suppression; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
